title: Feature request: allow automation to change ISF and IC without changing basal
symptom: The user wants to change insulin sensitivity factor (ISF) and insulin-to-carb ratio (IC) based on blood glucose, but existing methods (profile percentage change and profile change) have limitations: percentage change is restricted to 70-130% and also changes basal, while profile change stops autosens from working.
evidence_quote: Profile percentage change - the restrictions 70% to 130% are too tight and this method changes basal too Profile change - allows just changing ISF and IC but stops autosens working
